note: Each sign gets one pick. The pick is matched by sq (Square item id); name is for reference. Dates are month/day in Toronto time.

signs.name: Papilefiko Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Papilefiko is for the Capricorn who plays the long game. Cardamom and lavender open clean and composed, then balsam fir, styrax and moss settle in with the calm of a winter forest. Nothing about it is loud, and that is the point: it is the scent of someone who shows up early, keeps their word and quietly ends up running the place.

signs.name: Replica Jazz Club
signs.why: Jazz Club is for the Aquarius who would rather improvise than follow the sheet music. Pink pepper and neroli give way to rum, tobacco leaf and vanilla, with a curl of smoky styrax that feels like a late set in a basement bar. It is warm, social and a little offbeat, made for the friend who knows everyone in the room and still does things entirely their own way.

signs.name: La Melodie Maximal Parfum
signs.why: La Mélodie is for the Pisces who lives half in this world and half in a daydream. Sea notes and grapefruit drift in like a breeze off the water, then jasmine, ambergris and a soft pour of whisky give it a gentle, romantic depth. It is the scent for long walks with your headphones in, saying yes to the art show, and feeling everything a little more deeply than everyone else.

signs.name: Zoltan Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Zoltan is for the Aries who never waits to be asked. An icy rush of mint and grapefruit hits first, then cinnamon heat and red rose take over, finishing in leather and amber. It is fast, confident and a little fearless, the scent for walking into the interview, the first date or the starting line like you already know how it ends.

signs.name: Wulong Cha Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Wulong Cha is for the Taurus who believes the good life is made of small pleasures. Bergamot and sweet orange open over a warm cup of oolong tea and nutmeg, then fig and soft musk settle close to your skin. It is calm, unhurried and quietly luxurious, made for slow mornings, long lunches and a sign that never apologizes for enjoying life.

signs.name: Hacivat Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Hacivat is for the Gemini who can talk to anyone about anything. It takes its name from the quick-witted half of Turkey's famous shadow-puppet duo, and it plays both sides: pineapple and grapefruit sparkle up front, then cedar, patchouli and oakmoss give it a dry, clever finish. Bright one minute and grounded the next, it keeps up with you all day.

signs.name: Le Piano Eau de Parfum
signs.why: Le Piano is for the Cancer who makes everyone feel at home. Citrus and neroli open like a window on a summer morning, then sea notes, freesia and soft rose settle into clean white musk. It is gentle, familiar and easy to love, the scent for family barbecues, lake weekends and the people who already know you best.

signs.name: Tempfluo Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Tempfluo is for the Leo who lights up a room and knows it. Saffron, mandarin and bergamot glow like golden-hour sunshine, then orange blossom and praline add warmth before cashmere wood and vanilla carry you into the night. It is bright, generous and impossible to ignore, which is exactly how you like to make an entrance.

signs.name: Uomo (2021)
signs.why: Valentino Uomo is for the Virgo who notices when something is even slightly off, and makes sure it never is. Bergamot and lemon open crisp and exact, then powdery iris and earthy vetiver lead into a clean finish of cardamom and black pepper. It is understated, precise and always appropriate, the scent of someone whose shirt is pressed and whose plan has a backup.

signs.name: Ani Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Libra is ruled by Venus, and Ani is built on the notes astrologers have long tied to that planet: rose, vanilla, benzoin and sandalwood. Sharp ginger and bergamot keep them in check, so it never tips too sweet or too fresh. It moves from a Saturday brunch to a late dinner with the easy charm your sign is known for.

signs.name: Noir Eau de Parfum
signs.why: Tom Ford Noir is for the Scorpio who says little and notices everything. Violet and black pepper open with a dark shimmer, then iris and rose soften into leather, amber and a warm, animal edge that lingers on skin. It is the scent for the corner table, the conversation that goes deeper than planned, and the people who never quite figure you out.

signs.name: Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum
signs.why: Tuscan Leather is for the Sagittarius with a passport in one hand and a story in the other. Saffron and raspberry flash bright and a little wild, then supple leather and frankincense settle in like a well-worn travel jacket. It is bold and honest, never subtle, and it suits the friend who books the trip first and figures out the details on the plane.
